content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clauses reviewed:** § 7.1 (no conflict), § 7.2 (IP warranty), § 7.3 (product warranty + malicious code), § 7.4 (Y2K), § 7 disclaimer tail (p0084), § 3.1 acceptance testing, § 5 support/maintenance, § 11.2 (post-Warranty-Period conformance as material condition).
- **What fails:** the sole performance warranty runs only sixty (60) days from the Effective Date and is additionally capped at December 31, 1999 — short of the 90-day software conformance floor and capable of cutting the hosted-service warranty below 30 days.
- **What already met fallback:** correction/replacement free of charge and refund of prepaid fees on failure to correct (§ 7.3, second paragraph) — cited as already_met, not restated in the redline.
- **Cure:** one surgical replacement in p0078 changing "sixty (60)" to "ninety (90)" and deleting the outside date, preserving the defined term "Warranty Period" relied on in §§ 7.3 and 11.2 and all remedy and malicious-code language. No preferred-level extras (12-month term, workmanlike standard, compliance with laws) were volunteered.
